name: Cubing Summer Honduras 2023

venue.name: [Novacentro](http://www.novacentrolosproceres.com/)
venue.address: Centro Corporativo Los Próceres entre Boulevard Morazán y, Avenida la Paz, Tegucigalpa 11101

information:
Cubing Summer 2023 es el regreso a la capital del pais, se contara con premios para los primeros lugares de cada categoria y sera un evento abierto a competidores de cualquier nacionalidad. Tendremos varios patrocinios y actividades durante el dia.

_________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________


Cubing Summer 2023 is the return to the capital of the country, there will be prizes for the first places in each category and it will be an event open to competitors of any nationality. We will have various sponsorships and activities throughout the day.
